subject: Recovery roadmap and mutual action plan rebaseline: proposed go-live windows and risk ledger
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 May 2029 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Recovery roadmap and mutual action plan rebaseline: proposed go-live windows and risk ledger

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the open conversation yesterday. Attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP_v2) and a short close-risk ledger that calls out the two items still blocking our Q4 go-live: procurement SOC2 evidence review and your billing/legal redlines.

High-level ask: please confirm whether Acme can commit to a two-week procurement review window starting May 6 (proposed path A). If that timeline is not feasible, we propose a phased go-live (path B) where core clinical inference is enabled first and the patient-facing UI follows one week later.

Quick risk summary (short form):
- Procurement SOC2 review (blocking): if not completed within two weeks, we expect a 3–4 week slip to acceptance.
- Billing/contract redlines: finance has asked for one additional working session to finalize the SOW and billing cadence.
- Integration testing: minor KV-cache tuning required on our side — low-risk but requires a Saturday deploy if timeline compresses.

Next steps I propose this week:
1) Procurement: Acme provides SOC2 evidence packet (box link or zipped summary).
2) Legal/Finance: one 60-min redline session (I can host) — propose May 7 or May 9.
3) Internal: we’ll prepare a recovery-runbook with explicit fallbacks (canary, phased rollout, temporary throttles).

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed milestones), CloseRiskLog_draft.csv (risk rows).

Thanks — I’m happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the MAP and acceptance windows.

— Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
---

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Patel <c.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 07 May 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recovery roadmap and mutual action plan rebaseline: proposed go-live windows and risk ledger

Thanks Kimberly —

We reviewed the MAP and the proposed windows with procurement and legal. Two quick points: procurement is requesting the SOC2 evidence bundle before they can sign off; their earliest review slot is the week of May 13 given current backlog. Also, finance wants to walk through the consumption billing examples before agreeing to the cadence.

We can commit to a 14-day procurement review only if you share the SOC2 summary and key artifact map by COB May 8. If that’s not possible, we need to shift the acceptance windows out by three weeks.

I can do a redline session May 9 at 11:00 AM PT with finance and legal.

Also, can you confirm what a "phased" rollout would look like exactly (which endpoints, which integration points)? A short diagram would help.

Samantha
Sr. PM, Integrations | Acme Health
Samantha.Green@acmehealth.com

On Wed, May 1, 2029 at 08:32 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the open conversation yesterday....

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 May 2029 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recovery roadmap — internal note and risk recommendations

Kimberly — forwarding my short internal note. I talked to Finance and CS; they recommend we prepare an escalation credit request and a phased acceptance path to limit revenue disruption if procurement pushes.

Internal risk register excerpt (for Acme):
- Risk #1: Procurement backlog -> Likely 2–3 week delay; impact: deferred recognition of 60% of next quarter ARR. Mitigation: offer 30-day credit and "acceptance in stages" clause.
- Risk #2: Legal redlines -> Medium; impact: payment terms; mitigation: single redline session + drafting buffer clause.
- Risk #3: Integration test weekend -> Low; impact: minor schedule slip; mitigation: Saturday deploy with runbook.

Recommended internal asks for exec:
1) Approve a $15k credit buffer conditional on phased acceptance (internal approval needed).
2) Authorize CS to run a canary for up to 48 hours post-integration to capture behavior metrics.

I’ve attached a short one-pager we can share if we escalate to the Acme exec team.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recovery roadmap — internal note and risk recommendations

Team —

I agree with Marissa’s recommendations. Per procurement update: I reached out to Acme procurement lead (Chris Patel) and asked for a provisional review slot; they said they can expedite if we provide a summarized evidence matrix and a short SOC2 scoping memo.

Action items for exec ask:
- Kimberley/AE: finalize the evidence matrix and share with Chris by EOD May 9.
- CS(Product): confirm canary monitoring thresholds (Marissa).
- Sales Ops: pre-approve the $15k credit buffer (I’ll loop in Finance).

I’ve created a DocuSign pre-approval envelope for the credit buffer (link below). If exec approves, we can present the phased plan to Acme on the May 9 redline call.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/link/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2029-Q4-PIPE-47

— Jonas
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recovery roadmap — procurement lane update

Kim — quick status after my procurement call with Chris Patel:
- Procurement confirmed they received the SOC2 sample artifacts but need the one-page scoping memo to place Acme in the expedited queue.
- They tentatively moved us to a May 15 review slot if we provide the memo by COB May 9.

Suggested compromise for Acme:
A) If memo delivered by COB May 9 -> target acceptance window May 20–May 27 (path A, 2-week review).
B) If memo delayed -> acceptance window slides to June 10–June 17 (path B, 4+ week slip).

Contingency & ops plan I proposed to Chris: run a phased canary (core endpoints only) on May 25, then full acceptance the week after if metrics pass. That gives Acme time for procurement while preserving our ability to stagger recognition.

I’ll draft the scoping memo and the one-page evidence matrix; sending to Kimberly for review shortly.

— Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmehealth.com>, Chris Patel <c.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Bcc:
Date: Fri, 09 May 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recovery roadmap and mutual action plan rebaseline: proposed go-live windows and risk ledger — executive summary and next steps

Samantha / Chris —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Attached are: MAP_v3.xlsx (rebaselined milestones reflecting path A and path B), CloseRiskLog_20290509.csv (finalized risk entries for exec), and a one-page SOC2 scoping memo (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf).

Executive summary for Acme:
- If Acme delivers a procurement review on May 15 (we’ll confirm post-call), we can commit to a phased acceptance starting May 20 with a hard cutoff for full acceptance by May 27 (path A).
- If procurement cannot make the May 15 slot, acceptance will move to the June 10 window (path B).
- As mitigation we propose: a) phased canary on core endpoints, b) 30-day credit buffer pre-approved by Redwood (pending internal sign-off), c) Saturday deploy option to limit weekday impact.

Immediate asks:
1) Samantha: confirm on the May 9 11:00 AM redline session (we’ll host).
2) Chris: confirm receipt of the SOC2 memo and whether procurement can honor the May 15 slot if memo arrives by COB May 9.
3) Acme exec: if there’s a risk of sliding beyond June 10, please let us know — we’ll prepare an executive-level runbook to present recovery options.

Thanks — we’ll be on the redline call in 45 mins.

— Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, CloseRiskLog_20290509.csv, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf
